game.name: ASHVALE
game.description: New in 0.8.111: no more rain indoors, snow keeps falling while the ground is white, and candles and torches light only their own room. Roofs keep the sun out of rooms, and the card tables play Solitaire too. ASHVALE is free to play: knights, wizards and archers, the Saltmere Tap's card room upstairs, the Chess Park, and the Ojibwe village of Ziibiing on the far continent.
